Results:

-----------------------------

2  Joe Kollisch       10(+39)

3  Greg West           9(+90)



4  Karl Sundberg       9(+86)

-----------------------------



This tournamnet was great! We had a terrific turnout of 22 people. There is not mcu for me to say about this tournamnet because I spent most of my available time teachng a new player (Ashley) some of the finer skills of the game. To me this is more important than watching other players games.



I was very surpised to see a lot of EBO & MWYHL decks... Most of the winners today were playing Huntdown/BHBM/Scum decks for Dark and WYS/Hidden Mains/EBO for dark. And of Course I cannot forget to mention Karl’s Rumors Deck taht he always plays and Always wins with...



Most Memorable Moment of the Tournamnet:

  Dan Long Stealing Starships in Sabaac.





Props:

  My Boy Brian Henderson for doing so well. I’m gonna expect this from you every tournamnet now! [Grin]



  My Boy Jeremie DeWitt for toughing it out and Still Having fun and NOT giving up.



  Karl Sundberg for turning his luck against Brian Hollingworth.



  John Mullarky for Making the extra long drive to pick up Jeremie.



  Joe Kollisch for suprising Everybody!



  Anthony Muscaro for trading me the Imperial Decree Foil for my collection!



  Dan Long for playing Sabaac!  Gotta *LOVE* the sabaac!



  Josh Radke for showing up just to trade!



  Steve Brentson for another Great Tourney Win!



  Greg West for bringing another player into the Star Wars Environment!



  Ashley for helpong me pull a Palpy Foil from my packs of Reflections II.



  Finally, The weather for holding out...





Slops:

  To all the peopel that said they were gonna come and didn’t show. *Grumble*Klema&Dicara*Grumble*



  To me for my wrong Ruling on Out Of COmmision. MY BAD. My Apologies go to everyone on that one.  :-(



  Andrew Ledwith for not Winniing the Random FOil card.. You broke Your Streak Man! WTF?!
title: Meriden CT 03-10-2001 TD Report
author: Jeremy Oakes
event_desc: a 22-player tournament in Meriden, Connecticut, run by Jeremy Oakes
summary: Tournament director Jeremy Oakes reports the 22-player Meriden, Connecticut tournament of 10 March 2001, won by Steve Brentson (10, +83) ahead of Joe Kollisch and Greg West.
notes: TD report: Oakes did not play (he spent the day teaching a new player, Ashley); author_played false.

Same event as the live [[2001 Meriden Tournament]] hub: Meriden, March 2001, 'the weekend before 12 March', with Joe Kollisch 2nd (DeckTech deck 14524); Oakes also has Kollisch 2nd on Saturday 10 March. Hub title is not in the '<Month YYYY> <City> tournament' house style used for the January/February Meriden events; reused as instructed (rename candidate: 'March 2001 Meriden tournament').

Full standings with points: 1 Steve Brentson 10(+83), 2 Joe Kollisch 10(+39), 3 Greg West 9(+90), 4 Karl Sundberg 9(+86), 5 Andrew Ledwith 8(+58), 6 Brian Henderson 8(+33), 7 Tom Hollingworth 6(+38), 8 Pat Long 6(+21), 9 Brian Hollingworth 6(+16), 10 John Mullarkey 6(+16), 11 John Michaliszyn 6(+3), 12 Sean Orcutt 6(-12), 13 Anthony Muscaro 6(-14), 14 Patrick Gstell 6(-30), 15 Ryan Bietler 5(+24), 16 James Carrot 4(-27), 17 Keith Henderson 4(-40), 18 Dan Long 4(-45), 19 Tom Malley 4(-51), 20 Andrew Snelling 4(-54), 21 Jeremie DeWitt 2(-94), 22 Michael Bird 0(-141).
'James Carrot' mapped to [[James Carron]] (9th at the February 2001 Meriden tournament); likely misspelling.
Store not named (the January and February Meriden events were at DJs Comics); site left as Meriden, CT.
Venue/decks: most winners played Huntdown/BHBM/Scum (Dark) and WYS/Hidden Mains/EBO (Light; report says 'for dark'); Karl Sundberg played his Rumors deck.
Josh Radke came only to trade; Andy Klema and Cody DiCara were expected but didn't show.
